description: This file defines the RestaurantOrderEntry class and several API functions related to managing restaurant orders and invoices within an ERP system, using the Frappe framework.

classes.name: RestaurantOrderEntry
classes.description: A Document subclass representing restaurant order entries within the ERP system.

methods.name: get_invoice(table)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sales invoice linked to a restaurant table, setting default properties and linking to customer and tax templates.

methods.name: sync(table, items)
methods.description: Updates the sales invoice for a table with a list of items, saving and returning the invoice as a dictionary.

methods.name: make_invoice(table, customer, mode_of_payment)
methods.description: Creates and submits a sales invoice for a table with specified customer and payment mode, calculating totals and taxes.

methods.name: item_query_restaurant(doctype='Item', txt='', searchfield='name', start=0, page_len=20, filters=None, as_dict=False)
methods.description: Returns available restaurant items that are active in the restaurant's current menu, filtered by the restaurant data.

methods.name: get_restaurant_and_menu_name(table)
methods.description: Fetches the restaurant and active menu name associated with a given table, raising errors if data is missing.

ctags.name: item_query_restaurant

ctags.signature: (doctype='Item', txt='', searchfield='name', start=0, page_len=20, filters=None, as_dict=False)
